description: In every PA-model, nonzero recognized formula-depth decomposes its actual code into falsum, equality, implication or universal quantification, with the corresponding valid children.

    (∃ a b,

              Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ArithmeticTheories.zeroValue M ∧
            Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.SyntaxPrograms.termDepth b ≠
              Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ArithmeticTheories.zeroValue M) ∨
      (∃ a b,

                Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ArithmeticTheories.zeroValue M ∧
              Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.SyntaxPrograms.formDepth b ≠
                Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ArithmeticTheories.zeroValue M) ∨
        ∃ a,
          e = Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.SyntaxPrograms.modelNode 7 [a] ∧

              Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ArithmeticTheories.zeroValue M
